content.text: Ok, concerning submission, do I submit the paper and the optional Suppliment? Or, perhaps it depends on the journal? What about appending it in to the same PDF and putting the boolean\_interface in the appendix?

items.text:
**My recommendation is to submit the main paper with its computational supplement, and keep the Boolean-interface note separate for now.** The computations support claims made in the paper, so reviewers should receive the code and results. The [Boolean note](<C:/Users/brian/Documents/Math Latex etc/Papers for Publication/Chain Ring Contextuality and Exact Resources (P01)/REVISION_2026-09-26/supplement/boolean_interface.pdf>) is a conditional extension; none of the main theorems depends on it.

Yes, the upload format depends on the journal. For example, [Physical Review asks authors to upload supplemental material separately](https://journals.aps.org/authors/web-submission-guidelines-physical-review), while [Quantum permits supplementary files and has no general length constraint](https://quantum-journal.org/instructions/authors/). APS also advises that an article should stand on its own and that some technical material may fit better in an appendix. ([APS guidance](https://journals.aps.org/authors/supplemental-material-instructions))

I would **not append the Boolean note to the main PDF by default**. Even at two pages, it introduces a different symbolic coefficient ring and a process interpretation that could distract from the chain-ring classification. If a chosen journal or referee wants that connection developed, an appendix would be reasonable. Otherwise, it can remain a clearly labeled separate note—or be omitted from the journal submission. If omitted, remove the brief mention of it in the paper’s introduction.

The current revised ZIP contains both kinds of supplement, so it should be tailored to the chosen journal before upload. **Next step:** choose the target journal, then prepare its submission files in this task. No further model run is needed until that choice is made.
